alert.name: ClickStack · ClickHouse disk free < 10%
alert.message: The ClickHouse data disk has less than 10% free space. This is the single most common way a ClickStack deployment dies: once the disk fills, every INSERT fails with NOT_ENOUGH_SPACE, ingestion stops, and the dashboards silently go blank because no new data arrives. Act before it reaches zero - check 'Data retention & size by table (system.parts)' on the Observability Platform Health dashboard to find the largest tables, then either tighten the retention TTL or expand the volume.
